heading: Today
text: Any sun giving way to periods of clouds north. Cloudy south, with a chance of showers. Highs in the low 70s south, in the mid-70s to near 80 as you head north. Light wind becoming south to southeast near 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly cloudy, with a rising chance of scattered rain showers mainly south of Route 4. Lows from the upper 50s to near 60. Light wind.

heading: Sunday
text: Showers spreading north, with a chance of afternoon thunderstorms. Highs from the mid 70s to near 80. South wind near 10 mph.
